description: Unit tests for MtaStsCache using sqlx with SQLite in-memory database (sqlx::SqlitePool::connect(':memory:')). Test cases: store and retrieve policy for a domain, cached entry not expired (returns hit), cached entry expired (returns miss), policy_id change triggers cache miss, two different domains stored independently, cache miss for unknown domain returns None. All tests must run without touching the filesystem; use in-memory SQLite exclusively.
title: Tests: MTA-STS policy cache
